articles.title: EG-ARSA: An Expert-Grounded Open Model for Visual Road Safety Auditing in Low-Resource Settings
articles.content: Road traffic injuries remain a major challenge in low- and middle-income countries, where proactive road safety auditing is limited by incomplete crash records, shortages of qualified auditors, and the high cost of large-scale field inspections. To address this problem, we propose Expert-Grounded Distillation (EGD), a novel artificial intelligence framework that transfers institutional road safety expertise into a compact vision-language model for scalable visual road safety auditing. The key innovation is a quantified expert-grounding stage in which the teacher vision-language model is calibrated against authoritative field audits. Large-scale annotation is permitted only after the teacher reaches substantial agreement with expert risk assessments (Cohen's kappa = 0.74). The calibrated teacher then generates structured supervision that is distilled into an 8-billion-parameter student vision-language model using Low-Rank Adaptation and a single leakage-free prompt. We also introduce Bangladesh Road Safety Audit (BD-ARSA), the first open, expert-grounded Bangladeshi visual road safety audit dataset containing 21,947 image-audit records with near-national coverage, and Expert-Grounded Road Safety Auditor (EG-ARSA), the first vision-language model developed specifically for this task. Experimental results show that grounded fine-tuning substantially improves ordinal risk assessment over the zero-shot baseline, while blind expert evaluation demonstrates that the compact student outperforms both its 31 billion-parameter teacher and Gemini-2.5-Flash. These findings demonstrate that EGD provides an effective and scalable engineering solution for proactive road safety auditing in resource-constrained environments.

articles.title_zh: EG-ARSA:低资源环境下可视道路安全审计的专家组合开放模式
articles.content_zh: 在低收入和中等收入国家,道路交通伤害仍然是一项重大挑战,由于坠毁记录不完整、合格审计员短缺以及大规模实地检查费用高昂,对这些国家进行积极的道路安全审计受到限制。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议采用专家组合式的 " 扭曲 " (EGD),这是一个新的人工智能框架,将机构道路安全专门知识转化为可伸缩的目视道路安全审计的紧凑视觉语言模式。 关键创新是量化的专家定位阶段,教师愿景语言模式参照权威的实地审计进行校准。 只有在教师与专家风险评估(Cohen's kappa = 0.74)达成实质性协议后,才允许进行大规模注解。 校准的教师然后产生结构化的监导,利用Low-Rank适应和单一的无渗漏速率,将其蒸馏成80亿参数的学生视觉语言模型. 我们还介绍了孟加拉国道路安全审计(BD-ARSA),这是孟加拉国第一个开放的、以专家为基础的道路安全视觉审计数据集,其中载有21,947份近乎全国范围的图像审计记录,以及专家组合的道路安全审计(EG-ARSA),这是专门为这项任务开发的第一个愿景语言模式。 实验结果表明,有根据的微调大大改进了零射线基线的普通风险评估,而盲目专家评价则表明,紧凑的学生的成绩优于310亿参数的教师和双子座2.5-闪电。 这些调查结果表明,环境治理小组为在资源有限的环境中进行积极主动的道路安全审计提供了一个有效和可扩展的工程解决方案。

articles.title: FixAnything: 3D-Consistent Rendering Refinement via Video Generative Priors
articles.content: Rendering views using 3D scene representations such as Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), meshes, or even point clouds produces artifacts when input views are sparse or target views lie far from the input. Recent work mitigates these artifacts using diffusion-based generative priors, but is specialized to individual representations and require custom architectures or extensive retraining. We present FixAnything, a single model for fixing a wide range of rendering artifacts. It does so by repurposing a pretrained video generative model, leveraging its implicit multi-view priors with only minimal modification and lightweight finetuning. Our key insight is that even noisily-rendered sequences preserve camera motion and coarse scene structure, allowing cleanup to be formulated as video-to-video translation. To control what scene structure should be preserved, we introduce a binary mask denoting the clean pixels, enabling the model to anchor its output to high-quality inputs (e.g. training views) while refining the rest. To encourage FixAnything to produce 3D-consistent renderings that support downstream reconstruction, we use camera pose accuracy (recovered via structure-from-motion) as a reward signal for direct preference optimization (DPO). Across four distinct 3D representations, FixAnything consistently improves rendering quality with lightweight finetuning, demonstrating that a single generalist video prior can replace multiple specialist refinement pipelines. The simplicity of the framework enables immediate adoption of stronger future video models without architectural redesign.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 修复任何东西: 3D 持续渲染 视频基因前传
articles.content_zh: 使用3D场景表示的渲染视图,如高斯镀(3DGS),神经辐射场(NeRF),网点,甚至点云在输入视图稀疏或目标视图远离输入时产生文物. 最近的工作利用基于扩散的遗传学前科减轻了这些文物,但专门用于个人表现,需要定制建筑或广泛的再培训. 我们提出Fix Anything, 一个单一的模型,用于修复各种渲染文物。 它这样做的方式是重新使用经过预先训练的视频基因模型,利用其隐含的多视图前缀,仅进行最小的修改和轻量级微调. 我们的关键见解是,即使是无声的手动序列,也保留了相机运动和粗糙的场景结构,使得清理工作能够被制成视频到视频的翻译. 为了控制哪些场景结构应该保存,我们引入了二进制面具来解析干净的像素,使模型能够将其输出锁定在高质量的输入(如训练视图)上,同时精炼其余的. 为了鼓励Fix Anything制作支持下游重建的符合3D的渲染,我们使用相机摆出精度(通过结构自动回收)作为直接优化偏好(DPO)的奖励信号. 通过四个不同的三维表示,Fix Anything用轻量级微调不断提高渲染质量,表明之前的单一通论视频可以取代多个专业精细管道. 框架的简单化使得能够立即采用更强大的未来视频模型,而不重新设计建筑。

articles.title: Predicting Multiple Clinical Outcomes Related to Functional Recovery and Social Isolation Among Older Adults After Lower-Limb Fracture or Hip Replacement
articles.content: Older adults recovering after lower-limb fracture or hip replacement may experience complex recovery trajectories. Most of the time, these clinical aspects are studied in isolation, masking their joint impact on recovery. This study used the MAISON-LLF dataset, which contains multimodal sensor and clinical assessment data from 18 older adults recovering in the community after lower-limb fracture or hip replacement. Participants were monitored for up to eight weeks, corresponding to a maximum of 1,008 participant-days of sensor monitoring. Forty-six daily features were extracted from indoor motion, acceleration, step count, heart rate, out-of-home mobility, and sleep data. Five clinical outcomes were assessed every two weeks: the Social Isolation Scale, Oxford Hip Score, Oxford Knee Score, Timed Up and Go test, and 30-second Chair Stand test. We utilize an inherent relationship between multi-modal sensor data and different clinical scores and formulate it as a multi-output regression problem. We tested various machine learning and deep learning single- and multi-output regression algorithms to predict these scores simultaneously. The results showed that predicting clinical scores jointly was better than separately. The tabular DL multi-output regressor, NODE, gave a remarkable performance of MSE=3.96 and MAE=1.02 in comparison to other multi- and single-output regressors. The SHAP feature analysis further showed the importance of including multimodal sensors to provide a good estimate of patients' recovery trajectory. This work may support the simultaneous assessment of functional recovery and social engagement among community-dwelling older adults and ultimately help improve their care and quality of life.

articles.title_zh: 预测与功能恢复和社会隔离有关的多种临床结果
articles.content_zh: 在下肢骨折或臀部替换后康复的老年人可能经历复杂的恢复轨迹. 大多数时候,这些临床方面被孤立地研究,掩盖了其对恢复的共同影响. 这项研究使用了MAISON-LLF数据集,该数据集包含了18名在下游断裂或臀部替换后在社区康复的老年人的多式联运传感器和临床评估数据. 对参与者进行了长达8周的监测,相当于最多1 008个参与者日的传感器监测。 从室内运动,加速度,步数,心率,户外活动,睡眠数据中提取出46个日常特征. 每两周评估5个临床结果:社会隔离尺度、牛津Hip积分、牛津膝盖积分、Timed Up和Go测试以及30秒主席立体测试。 我们利用多式联运传感器数据和不同临床分数之间的内在关系,将其表述为多产出回归问题。 我们测试了各种机器学习和深入学习的单输出和多输出回归算法,以同时预测这些分数. 结果显示,共同预测临床分数比单独预测好。 表格DL多输出后退器NODE与其他多输出后退器和单输出后退器相比,MSE=3.96和MAE=1.02的性能显著. SHAP的特征分析进一步表明,必须纳入多式传感器,以便对病人的康复轨迹作出良好的估计。 这项工作可以支持同时评估社区老年人的功能恢复和社会参与,并最终帮助改善他们的照料和生活质量。

articles.title: Investigating Relational Reasoning in VLMs
articles.content: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) achieve strong performance in visual reasoning tasks, but it remains unclear whether they understand visual relations, or simply employ shortcuts such as language cues or priors. To investigate this, we use the Qwen3-VL-4B (Bai et al., 2025), a modern VLM, to decode how visual information is encoded across depths. For this, we propose a synthetic dataset of simple geometric shapes for controlled analysis, along with queries crafted to precisely test language cues. Furthermore, the dataset is modified to test causal reliance on visual evidence. Our results show that current VLMs combine genuine visual reasoning with shortcut strategies primarily rooted in language cues.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: B. 自愿参与调查中的关系原因
articles.content_zh: Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)在视觉推理任务中实现了强效性能,但是仍然不清楚他们是否理解视觉关系,还是简单地使用语言提示或前传等快捷方式. 为了调查这一点,我们使用一种现代VLM的Quen3-VL-4B(Bai等人,2025年)来解码视觉信息如何通过深度编码. 为此,我们提出一个由简单的几何形状组成的合成数据集,用于控制分析,以及精确测试语言提示而设计的查询。 此外,对数据集进行了修改,以测试对视觉证据的因果关系。 我们的结果显示,目前的VLM将真正的视觉推理和主要根植于语言提示的捷径策略结合起来.

articles.title: Action-Aligned Retrieval with Pairwise Multimodal Reranking for Text-Based Person Anomaly Search
articles.content: Text-based person anomaly search requires distinguishing individuals based on fine-grained, context-dependent behaviors rather than mere appearance. Existing methods struggle to capture these context-conditioned actions, frequently relying on isolated skeletal geometry, discarding raw query details during reformulation, or utilizing absolute pointwise scoring for multimodal verification. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{ActPair}, a unified three-stage coarse-to-fine framework that combines action-aligned retrieval with pairwise multimodal reranking to bridge the pose-semantic gap. First, we fine-tune a vision-language model (VLM) with an action-aligned multi-task objective that encourages the representations to encode action-discriminative semantics. Second, we perform parallel late-fusion retrieval using the original query and a large language model (LLM)-generated context-grounded rewrite, retaining complementary details from both semantic views. Finally, we propose an efficient off-the-shelf reranking module that leverages a pivot-promote algorithm to perform direct pairwise visual comparisons, mitigating residual spatial and compositional ambiguities without the prohibitive inference costs of exhaustive evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves the best results among the compared methods on the Pedestrian Anomaly Behavior (PAB) public test and transfers effectively to an unseen, non-anomaly-specific dataset.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 以对等方式重排基于文本的人异常搜索的动作检索
articles.content_zh: 基于文字的人异常搜索需要根据精细的,上下文依赖的行为来区分个人,而不是单纯的外观. 现有方法难以捕捉这些符合上下文条件的动作,经常依赖孤立的骨骼几何,在重制过程中丢弃原始查询细节,或者使用绝对点评进行多式联运验证. 为了克服这些限制,我们提议\textbf{ActPair},一个统一的三阶段粗对细框架,将动作对齐检索与双向多式重排相结合,以弥补姿势-语义差距。 首先,我们微调了一种视觉语言模式(VLM),使之具有与行动相协调的多任务目标,鼓励表述将行动-歧视语义编码。 第二,我们利用原始查询和大型语言模型(LLM)生成的上下文重写进行平行的晚聚检索,保留两种语义观点的补充细节. 最后,我们提出一个有效的现成重排模块,利用一个枢轴促进算法进行直接对映的视觉比较,减少剩余空间和构成上的模糊不清,而无需详尽评估的令人望而却步的推论费用。 广泛的实验表明,我们的框架在Pedestria Anomaly行为(PAB)的比较方法中取得了最佳结果,并有效地向一个看不见的、非异常特定的数据集转移。

articles.title: SVD-Based Typicality Maps for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Vision Transformers
articles.content: We present a method for analyzing the internal representations of Vision Transformers (ViTs) exploiting the geometry of their learned parameters. Each affine layer's weight matrix is factored via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), and activations are projected onto the leading right singular vectors to obtain compact, layer-intrinsic representations. A class-conditional density model is then fitted at each layer, producing per-class \emph{typicality scores} that are stacked across depth into \emph{typicality maps}: two-dimensional summaries of how class-specific evidence evolves through the network. From these maps, we derive two post-hoc scores for Out-Of-Distribution (OOD) detection: a \emph{Prototype Alignment Score} (PAS), measuring agreement with class reference prototype patterns, and a \emph{Multi-Layer Soft Voting} (MLSV) score, capturing cross-layer consensus without stored prototypes. On ViT-B/16 fine-tuned on CIFAR-100, the proposed scores achieve competitive detection performance without retraining or OOD exposure.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SVD 基于视觉变形器中分布外检测的典型性映射
articles.content_zh: 我们提出一种方法,分析视觉变形器(ViTs)利用所学参数几何特征的内部表现。 每个芳香层的权重矩阵通过Singular值分解(SVD)进行系数化,激活被投射到右前列单向量上,以获得紧凑的,层层内涵的表示. 然后在每个层安装一个类条件密度模型,生成每个级的\emph{典型分数},这些分数被堆叠到深度\emph{典型分数图}: 二维摘要,说明特定类证据如何通过网络演变. 从这些地图中,我们得出了两个"Out-Out-Dissibution(OOD)"检测的Hoc后分数:一个\emph{Prototype Accord Score}(PAS),用类参考原型模式测量协议,和一个\emph{Multi-Layer Soft Sootball}(MLSV)分数,在没有存储原型的情况下捕获跨层共识. 在对CIFAR-100进行微调的Vit-B/16上,建议的分数实现了无再培训或OOD曝光的竞争性检测性能.

articles.title: GeoWAM: Visual Geometry World Action Models for Autonomous Driving
articles.content: World action models (WAMs) have recently gained increasing attention as a framework for jointly modeling scene evolution and ego actions in autonomous driving. Most existing WAMs learn scene dynamics in pixel space by combining a video-generation backbone for future-observation prediction with an action head for ego-trajectory prediction. Pixels, however, provide only an indirect representation of these dynamics: they entangle geometry and motion with appearance, texture, and illumination, forcing the model to infer three-dimensional transformations from two-dimensional observations. We argue that geometry, represented by point clouds, offers a more natural state space for driving because it explicitly captures spatial structure and the rigid and non-rigid transformations that govern scene evolution while directly aligning with the space in which driving actions are executed. Building on this insight, we introduce \textbf{GeoWAM}, a visual geometry world action model for autonomous driving. Rather than predicting future images, GeoWAM is pretrained to forecast future scene geometry, yielding representations that jointly encode spatial structure and temporal evolution. A geometry-conditioned action head then leverages these learned geometric dynamics to predict future ego trajectories. Extensive open-loop and closed-loop evaluations show that visual geometry world modeling yields substantially stronger driving policies than image-based alternatives, establishing future-geometry prediction as an effective pretraining objective for autonomous driving.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GeoWAM:视觉几何世界自主驾驶行动模式
articles.content_zh: 最近,世界行动模式作为共同模拟场景演变和自主驾驶的自我行动的框架,日益受到重视。 大多数现存的WAM在像素空间学习场景动力学,方法是将未来观测预测的视频生成主干线与自我-弹射预测的动作头结合起来. 然而,像素只提供了这些动力学的间接表现:它们用外观,纹理,和光线来缠绕几何和运动,迫使模型从二维观测中推断出三维转变. 我们主张,以点云为代表的几何学为驾驶提供了更自然的状态空间,因为它明确捕捉空间结构以及制约场景演化的刚性和非刚性转变,同时直接与执行驱动动作的空间一致. 基于这一见解,我们引入了\textbf{GeoWAM},一种视觉几何世界动作模型,用于自主驾驶. GeoWAM不是对未来的图像进行预测,而是预先接受过预测未来场景几何的训练,得出联合编码空间结构和时间演化的表示. 一个有几何条件的动作头,然后利用这些学到的几何动力来预测未来的自我轨迹. 广泛的开放式和封闭式评价表明,视觉几何世界模型的驱动政策比基于图像的替代品要强得多,将未来几何预测确定为自主驱动的有效前训练目标。

articles.title: Geometry-Driven Opti-Acoustic Co-Registration and View-Invariant Reflectivity Mapping for Side-Scan Sonar
articles.content: Side-Scan Sonar (SSS) is a primary modality for large-scale underwater mapping, yet automated perception and cross-modal alignment are severely bottlenecked by acoustic complexities such as speckle noise, shadows, and extreme viewpoint dependencies. Traditional handcrafted descriptors and modern deep learning matchers fail to bridge the physical domain gap between optical and acoustic imagery without 3D geometric constraints. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel geometry-driven framework for pixel-level opti-acoustic co-registration and view-invariant reflectivity mapping. Our method utilizes Structure-from-Motion (SfM) to reconstruct a dense 3D seafloor mesh, acting as a geometric anchor between the visual and acoustic domains. We introduce a First Bottom Return (FBR) extraction algorithm to dynamically correct non-linear altitude drift caused by uncalibrated SfM reconstruction. Furthermore, we apply an inverse Lambertian model and a dual-Gaussian weighting function to isolate the intrinsic seabed reflectivity, effectively neutralizing slant-range propagation loss and geometric view-dependence. By deterministically associating these isolated acoustic properties with optical pixels, our pipeline generates highly accurate, strictly co-registered multi-modal datasets. This automated, physics-guided approach eliminates the need for manual annotation and paves the way for advanced self-supervised learning in benthic habitat mapping.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 几何- 驱动 Opti- 声学联合注册和视图- 变量反射映射用于侧向扫描声纳
articles.content_zh: Side-Scan Sonar(SS)是大规模水下测绘的主要方式,然而,由于声学复杂,如光谱噪音、阴影和极端视线依赖性,自动感知和跨模式对接受到严重瓶颈。 传统的手工描述符和现代深层学习匹配符未能弥合光学和声学图像之间没有3D几何限制的物理域间差距. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提出一个新型的几何驱动框架,用于像素级的选声学共录和视图偏差反射映射. 我们的方法利用结构-从运动(SfM)重建密集的3D海底网,充当视觉和声域之间的几何锚地。 我们引入了一种First Bottom Return(FBR)提取算法,以动态校正未校准的SfM重建导致的非线性高度漂移. 此外,我们采用了反向朗贝特模型和双重加乌西加权功能,以隔离内在的海底反射性,有效地中和斜距传播损失和几何视差依赖。 通过确定将这些孤立的声学特性与光学像素连接起来,我们的管道产生高度准确、严格注册的多式数据集。 这种自动化的物理指导方法消除了人工注释的必要性,并为海底生境测绘方面的高级自我监督学习铺平了道路。

articles.title: Act with Intent: Distilling Behavior Intent for Vision-Language-Action Models
articles.content: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can turn multimodal context into robot actions, but their action decoders are still trained largely by behavior cloning. This supervises which motor command was demonstrated while leaving implicit the local objective served by the behavior under the instruction. Future-based supervision enriches action learning with frames, latent observations, trajectories, or motion representations, but these signals capture particular realizations of what may happen rather than the shared semantic objective of the forthcoming behavior. We propose Intention Distillation (INDI), which distills behavior-level intent into the action decoder. During training, a frozen teacher VLM interprets a demonstrated segment from the current observation, instruction, coarse action summary, and corresponding execution video. From its standard inputs, the deployed VLA recovers the resulting multimodal intent representation at an intermediate decoder layer and uses it to organize action prediction together with representations of how the behavior unfolds and what it achieves. On SimplerEnv-Bridge, INDI improves GR00T-N1.7 from 64.3% to 84.7%, and on RoboCasa Kitchen it improves the controlled GR00T-N1.7 baseline from 64.1% to 70.3%, with consistent gains on $π_{0.5}$ across both benchmarks. In real-world tasks, INDI improves average success from 62.0% to 68.7%, with gains of up to 12.0 pp on longer-horizon tasks. Further analyses show that the recovered latent is used by the decoder, captures behavior objective and execution progress, and organizes downstream predictions in an objective-dependent manner. These results show that action decoders benefit from explicitly modeling the semantic objective of the behavior they generate.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 与意向行动:对愿景-语言-行动模式的扭曲行为意图
articles.content_zh: Vision-Language-Action(VLA)模型可以将多式联运上下文变成机器人动作,但其动作解码器仍然主要通过行为克隆来训练. 这监督了哪些运动命令被演示,同时隐含了指令下的行为所服务的地方目标. 未来监督通过帧,潜伏观测,轨迹,或运动表达来丰富动作学习,但这些信号捕捉到可能发生的特定实现,而不是未来行为的共同语义目标. 我们提出意向分解(Indention distillation),将行为层面的意向分解为动作解码器. 在培训期间,一个冷冻的教师VLM从目前的观察、指示、粗糙动作摘要和相应的执行录像中解释一个演示部分。 所部署的VLA从其标准输入中恢复了由此产生的中间解码层的多式联运意向表示,并用它来组织动作预测,以及表现行为如何进行以及实现什么. 在SimmerEnv-Bridge上,INDI改进了GR00T-N1.7,从64.3%提高到84.7%;在RoboCasa厨房上,它改进了GR00T-N1.7控制基准,从64.1%提高到70.3%,在两个基准上,以0.5美元为单位的一致收益。 在现实世界的任务中,INDI提高了平均成功率,从62.0%提高到68.7%,在更长的视野任务上的收益高达12.0pp. 进一步的分析显示,回收的潜伏物被解码器使用,捕捉行为目标和执行进展,并以客观依赖的方式组织下游预测. 这些结果显示,动作解码器从明确模拟它们产生的行为的语义目标中受益.

articles.title: What's the Catch? Evaluating Temporal Consistency in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance on video and image-sequence benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether they capture temporal structure. To study this question, we formulate temporal grounding as an anomaly detection problem, providing a simple and controlled evaluation that directly tests sensitivity to temporal consistency. We introduce TimeCatch, where temporal anomalies are created by swapping consecutive frames and frame-level anomalies by replacing a frame with Gaussian noise. Models are evaluated on anomaly detection and localization tasks across four synthetic and real-world datasets, alongside a human study. Our evaluation reveals a substantial gap between frame-level and temporal anomaly detection. While VLMs consistently detect frame-level anomalies and often localize them accurately, they perform near chance on temporal anomaly detection and only modestly above chance on localization. Humans, in contrast, achieve near-ceiling performance on both tasks. Additional analyses across model scales, prompting strategies, sequence lengths, and visual similarity suggest that these failures cannot be explained solely by limitations in perception or model capacity. Together, these findings indicate that current VLMs can identify anomalies within individual frames but struggle to integrate information across frames to reason about temporal consistency. TimeCatch provides a controlled benchmark for evaluating temporal grounding in vision-language models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: "捕捉号"是什么? 评价愿景-语言模式的同步性
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)在视频和图像序列基准上取得了强劲的性能,然而它们是否捕捉时间结构仍然不清楚. 为了研究这个问题,我们把时间定位定为一个异常探测问题,提供一种简单而有控制的评价,直接测试时间一致性的敏感性。 我们引入了TimeCatch,通过将连续帧和帧级异常换成高斯噪声来创造时间异常. 在进行一项人类研究的同时,对四个合成和现实世界数据集的异常探测和本地化任务进行模型评估。 我们的评价显示,帧水平和时间异常探测之间存在巨大差距。 虽然VLM持续检测帧级异常,并经常准确定位,但它们在时间异常检测上表现的几近偶然性,在本地化上仅略高于偶然性. 相比之下,人类在这两项任务上都取得了接近天顶的性能. 跨模型尺度的其他分析,激发策略,序列长度,以及视觉相似性,都表明这些失败不能仅仅以认知或模型能力的局限性来解释. 这些调查结果加在一起表明,目前的VLM可以识别单个框架中的异常现象,但为了说明时间一致性的原因,在跨框架整合信息方面却困难重重. TimeCatch为在视觉语言模型中评价时间定位提供了一个可控基准.

articles.title: Towards Comprehensive Basketball Understanding
articles.content: Understanding a basketball game requires recognizing events, localizing actions, identifying players, and relating these to structured game knowledge. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate these abilities one at a time, leaving the interactions among these abilities under-explored. We introduce BasketballBench, a multimodal benchmark comprising 7,980 questions across ten tasks in text, image, and video. It is built from the 2025-2026 NBA season and includes official playby-play, rosters and profiles for 530 active players, and 2,501 possession-level broadcast clips. We further propose BasketballSkills, an agent that composes eight basketball-specific perception and retrieval tools under four reusable skills that specify tool order, evidence bindings, and stopping conditions. Experiments show that current MLLMs struggle particularly on questions requiring the integration of multiple capabilities, whereas BasketballSkills outperforms them, highlighting the effectiveness of explicitly composing domain-specific capabilities for comprehensive basketball understanding.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 争取全面理解篮球
articles.content_zh: 理解一个篮球游戏需要识别事件,将动作本地化,识别玩家,并将它们与结构化的游戏知识联系起来. 现有基准主要一次评估这些能力,使这些能力之间的相互作用没有得到充分利用。 我们介绍了篮球奔驰,这是一个由7,980个问题组成的多式联运基准,涉及文本、图像和视频方面的10项任务。 它建于2025-2026年NBA赛季,包括530名现役球员的官方玩法,名册和简介,以及2,501个拥有级广播片段. 我们进一步提出篮球技能(BasketballSkills),这个代理在四种可重复使用的技能下组成了八种篮球特有的感知和检索工具,这些技能具体规定了工具顺序,证据绑定,以及停止条件. 实验表明,目前的MLLMS在需要整合多种能力的问题上尤其挣扎,而篮球技能则优于这些能力,突出了明确构成域特定能力以全面理解篮球的有效性.

articles.title: Image-Conditioned Diffusion Models for Quality Assurance of Organ-at-Risk Segmentations in Radiotherapy
articles.content: Accurate organ-at-risk segmentation is essential for radiotherapy planning, but reviewing segmentations is time-consuming and subjective. We investigate normative modelling for segmentation error detection in head-and-neck CT, comparing a VAE framework with an image-conditioned segmentation diffusion model. Models were evaluated on RADCURE brainstem and spinal cord segmentations using simulated boundary and width perturbations. Error detection was assessed using the Dice similarity coefficient and the Distance to Agreement (DTA) between the input and reconstructed segmentations. While both models detected some simulated errors, regional DTA showed that the diffusion model localised subtle boundary errors more consistently. These results support image-conditioned diffusion reconstruction as a promising framework for localised, anatomy-aware segmentation QA.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 放射治疗中有机体危险分解质量保证的图像化扩散模型
articles.content_zh: 准确的器官风险分裂对于放射治疗规划至关重要,但审查分裂是耗时和主观的. 我们调查了在头部和颈部CT中分解误差检测的规范建模,将VAE框架与图像条件分解扩散模型进行比较. 利用模拟边界和宽度扰动,对RADCURE脑电图和脊髓分离模型进行了评估。 利用Dice相似系数和输入区段与重建区段之间的距离(DTA)来评估发现错误。 虽然这两个模型都检测到一些模拟错误,但区域DTA显示,扩散模型更一致地将微妙的边界错误本地化. 这些成果支持了以图像为条件的传播重建,作为地方化、解剖意识分解的有希望的框架。

articles.title: Photorealistic Novel View Synthesis of Human Faces using Next-Scale Transformers
articles.content: Photorealistic novel view synthesis of people remains challenging at high spatial resolutions and across multiple target cameras, where preserving identity, fine appearance details, and geometric coherence is critical. We build on the next-scale autoregressive paradigm and adapt it for human-centric view synthesis by enabling higher image resolutions, multi-view outputs and stronger cross-view consistency in a single forward pass. We train on a synthetic dataset of human faces spanning diverse identities and apparel. Contrary to diffusion models, this paradigm does not need 2D pre-training and, thanks to its next-scale architecture, it benefits from lower-resolution, general-purpose pre-trainings, with the full-sized purpose-specific images being used only in the last training stages. This enables our architecture to converge with a smaller amount of purpose-specific training data, allowing us to use a smaller but more realistic training dataset. The resulting model produces sharp and realistic views, with the option to synthesize multiple novel viewpoints simultaneously for improved agreement across views. Empirically, we observe gains in perceptual fidelity and cross-view coherence on human subjects, demonstrating that next-scale autoregression is an effective backbone for scalable, multi-output human view synthesis. We also couple our pipeline with an existing transformer-based model for pixel-aligned 3D gaussian lifting from multi-view facial inputs, resulting in accurate and photorealistic 3D models of human faces.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 摄影现实主义 使用下级变形器合成人脸小说
articles.content_zh: 在高空间分辨率和跨越多个目标相机时,人们的光现实主义新视角合成仍然具有挑战性,在这些相机中,保存身份、精细的外观细节和几何一致性至关重要。 我们以下级的自递式范式为基础,通过使图像分辨率更高,多视图输出和单一前行中更强的交叉视图一致性,使之适应以人为中心的观点合成. 我们用合成的人类面孔数据集来训练 包括不同的身份和服装 与传播模式相反,这个范式不需要2D预训,由于它的下级架构,它得益于低分辨率,通用预训,全尺寸的特有目的图像只在最后的培训阶段使用. 这使得我们的架构能够与数量较少的针对特定目的的培训数据汇合,使我们能够使用一个较小但更现实的培训数据集。 由此产生的模式产生了尖锐和现实的观点,可以同时综合多种新观点,以改进各种观点之间的一致意见。 从经验上看,我们看到在人类主体的认知忠诚度和交叉视野一致性方面的进步,表明下级自旋是可伸缩,多输出的人类视野合成的有效支柱. 我们还将我们的管道与一个基于变压器的现有模型对齐,该模型用于多视图面部输入的像素对齐的3D Gaussian提升,从而产生了准确和光现实的3D人脸模型.

articles.title: MomADv2: Reliable Temporal Memory for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
articles.content: Long-horizon planning is critical for safe autonomous driving in complex scenarios. Existing methods improve planning continuity with temporal memory, but such memory may become invalid and mislead decisions when the driving command changes. Thus, selectively leveraging useful history while suppressing command-inconsistent memory remains a key challenge. To address this issue, we propose MomADv2, a reliable state-space memory framework for long-horizon end-to-end autonomous driving. At its core, MomADv2 introduces a Selective State-Space Planning Memory Query Module, which filters historical planning queries based on temporal continuity and command consistency, selects planning modes relevant to the current command, and models the evolution of planning intentions through a selective state-space mechanism. To further alleviate local trajectory deviations and error accumulation in long-horizon planning, we design a Flow-Matching Trajectory Residual Refiner. It learns a continuous residual correction field from the refined planning output to the expert trajectory, enabling fine-grained trajectory refinement while preserving the stability of anchor-based planning. Extensive experiments on closed-loop NAVSIM and Bench2Drive, as well as open-loop nuScenes, demonstrate that MomADv2 improves long-horizon planning consistency and reduces the average collision rate by 15.6% over MomAD under 6-second planning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Momadv2: 端到端自主驱动的可靠时间记忆
articles.content_zh: 长视距规划对于复杂情况下的安全自主驾驶至关重要. 现有方法用时间记忆来改进规划的连续性,但这种记忆可能变得无效,并在驱动命令改变时误导决定. 因此,有选择地利用有用的历史,同时压制命令不一致的记忆,仍然是一个关键的挑战。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议MMADv2,一个用于长视距端对端自主驱动的可靠的状态空间记忆框架. Momadv2的核心是引入了选择状态-空间规划内存查询模块,该模块根据时间连续性和指令一致性过滤历史规划查询,选择与当前指令相关的规划模式,并通过选择状态-空间机制模拟规划意图的演变. 为了在长视距规划中进一步缓解局部轨迹偏差和误差积累,我们设计了"流量匹配轨迹残余炼油机". 它从精细的规划产出到专家轨迹,不断学习一个剩余校正领域,使精细的轨迹得以完善,同时保持锚定规划的稳定性。 关于闭路NAVSIM和Bench2Drive以及开路nuScens的广泛实验表明,MOMADv2改进了长距离规划的一致性,并在6秒规划下将平均碰撞率比MOMAD降低15.6%.

articles.title: Long-Horizon Audio-Visual Generation for Persistent Stories and Interactive Worlds
articles.content: Video generation is progressing beyond isolated clips toward long-form narratives and interactive worlds, requiring models to preserve identities, follow user controls, and remain stable over extended rollouts. We present JoyAI-Echo-1.5, a unified audio-visual generation system with two purpose-built variants. The long-video variant introduces composable cross-shot memory that aggregates visual evidence across multiple prior shots and speaker cues derived from speech-filtered full-shot audio, enabling persistent character appearance and voice identity across flexible combinations of text, image, and memory conditioning. The world-model variant converts heterogeneous navigation inputs into calibrated metric 6-DoF camera trajectories and injects them through a geometry-aware conditioning pathway, enabling controller-agnostic interaction across flexible viewpoints. To support efficient long-horizon generation, we transform a bidirectional audio-visual backbone into a causal few-step generator using progressive teacher forcing and short- and long-horizon Self-Gradient Forcing on self-generated rollouts. Experiments demonstrate strong performance in both settings. JoyAI-Echo-1.5 achieves improvements over existing long-video baselines in cross-shot consistency, visual quality, text alignment, and speech fidelity. Its world-model variant ranks first on WBench, with an average score of 81.7, and achieves leading visual quality and long-horizon persistence on SANA-WM-Bench. Together, these results indicate that memory, geometric control, and rollout-aware training provide a practical foundation for generating coherent stories and continuously evolving interactive worlds. Project page: https://echo-team-joy-future-academy-jd.github.io/Echo-1.5-Page/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 为持续故事和互动世界制作长视音像
articles.content_zh: 视频生成正在超越孤立的片段,走向长式叙事和互动世界,需要模型保存身份,遵循用户控制,并在扩展推出后保持稳定. 我们介绍JoyAI-Echo-1.5,一个统一的视听生成系统,有两个目的制造的变体。 长视频变体引入了可混杂的交叉镜头内存,通过多个前镜头和扬声器提示来集合视觉证据,这些提示来自语音过滤的全镜头音频,使得持续的角色外观和语音身份能够跨越文字,图像和内存的灵活组合. 世界模型变体将各种导航输入转换为校准的度量衡6-DoF相机轨迹,并通过几何-知觉调节路径注入,使控制器-可知性相互作用跨越灵活的观点。 为了支持高效的长视距生成,我们将双向视听骨干改造为因果的几步生成器,采用进步的教师强迫和短视和长视自强在自创推出上进行. 实验在两种场合都表现出强效性能. JoyAI-Echo-1.5比现有的长视频基线在交叉拍摄一致性、视觉质量、文本对齐和语音忠贞性方面实现改进。 它的世界型变体在WBench上排名第一,平均得分为81.7,并在SANA-WM-Bench上实现了领先的视觉质量和长视距持久性. 这些结果共同表明,记忆、几何控制和推广意识培训为产生连贯的故事和不断演变的互动世界提供了一个实际基础。 项目网页:https://echo-team-joy-future-academy-jd.github.io/Echo-1.5-Page/.

articles.title: DF-MoE: Generalizable Deepfake Detection via Multimodal Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
articles.content: Audio-visual deepfake detection is an actively studied topic, where one of the main challenges is to develop detectors able to generalize across deepfake generation methods. We conjecture that overfitting can be mitigated by extracting multiple high-level cues from the available audio and visual modalities via pre-trained models. We therefore assemble a wide variety of pre-trained models to extract features that encode mouth movements, face parsing, facial expressions, head pose, gaze tracking, heart rate, audio emotion and speech activity. We further integrate both unimodal and multimodal cues via a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) backbone to detect deepfakes. We perform in-domain and cross-domain experiments on five benchmarks for deepfake detection (MAVOS-DD, AVLips, PolyGlotFake, BioDeepAV, FakeAVCeleb) to compare our framework (DF-MoE) with state-of-the-art methods. Our results indicate that DF-MoE obtains superior deepfake detection results, surpassing all competing methods. We release our code at https://github.com/vladhondru25/DF-MoE.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DF-MOE: 通用深假检测
articles.content_zh: 视听深假探测是一个积极研究的课题,主要挑战之一是开发能够跨越深假生成方法的探测器。 我们猜想,通过预先训练的模型,从现有的视听模式中提取多个高级提示,可以缓解过度调整。 因此,我们汇集了各种各样的预先训练过的模型,以提取编码口腔动作,面部剖析,面部表情,头部姿势,目光跟踪,心率,音频情感和语音活动等特征. 我们通过专家混合骨干进一步整合单式和多式联运的提示,以检测深层假象。 我们在深假检测的五个基准(MAVOS-DD, AVLips, PolyGlotFake, BioDeepAV, FakeAVCeleb)上进行内域和跨域实验,以比较我们的框架(DF-MoE)与最先进的方法. 我们的结果显示,DF-MOE获得了优异的深假检测结果,超过了所有相互竞争的方法. 我们在https://github.com/vladhondru25/DF-MoE发布我们的代码。

articles.title: OptiSight: Bridging Semantic Reasoning and Geometric Control for Embodied Navigation
articles.content: Autonomous indoor navigation requires both semantic understanding and precise geometric control. We propose OptiSight, a hybrid framework that combines Vision-Language Model reasoning with deterministic visual servoing through a finite-state Chain-of-Thought architecture. Grounded-SAM localizes open-vocabulary targets, while camera projection geometry converts visual observations into navigation commands without requiring dense mapping. The VLM is queried only at key decision points, reducing computational overhead while geometric control handles continuous navigation. Experiments in AI Habitat demonstrate reliable zero-shot navigation across diverse indoor scenarios, including obstacle avoidance and semantic ambiguity, while operating within an 8~GB VRAM budget. The source code is available at https://github.com/avanalperen/OptiSight-Python-Multimodal-CoT-for-Visual-Reasoning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OptiSight:将语义推理和几何控制连接起来,用于健康导航
articles.content_zh: 自主室内导航既需要语义理解,也需要精确的几何控制. 我们提出"OptiSight"(OptiSight),一个混合框架,通过有限状态链式思维架构,将视觉-语言模型推理与定型视觉伺服相结合. 地面-SAM本地化了开放-vocabulary目标,而相机投影几何将视觉观测转换成导航指令而不需要密集绘图. VLM只在关键决定点被询问,减少计算间接费用,而几何控制处理持续导航。 AI Habitat的实验显示,在8~GB VRAM预算范围内运行时,在各种室内情景中,包括避免障碍和语义模糊,都具有可靠的零射导航能力。 源代码见https://github.com/avanalperen/OptiSight-Python-Multimodule-CoT- for-Visual-Reasoning.

articles.title: Controllable blind deblurring with diffusion models
articles.content: Image acquisition with a camera involves several degradations due to the optical system, sensor, or low-level processing steps. We address blind deblurring in professional photography: we aim to invert unknown isotropic blur without knowledge of the degradation kernel.For such inverse problems,where some high-frequency information is lost, it is challenging to use generative models to produce details that are both photo-realistic and faithful to the input. We propose SuperSharpen, a diffusion-based blind deblurring method offering explicit control over restoration strength through a blur measure. We compare two conditioning strategies: a ControlNet-style adapter on a frozen backbone, and full finetuning of the diffusion prior. Our experiments show that finetuning achieves better fidelity with fewer hallucinated details. We validate our approach on synthetic and real-world blur, demonstrating improved perceptual quality and controllable restoration strength.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用扩散模型进行可控盲解
articles.content_zh: 使用照相机获取图像涉及由于光学系统、传感器或低级处理步骤造成的若干退化。 我们在专业摄影中处理盲目破坏问题:我们的目标是在不了解退化内核的情况下颠倒未知的异热带模糊。 对于这种反向问题,当一些高频信息丢失时,使用基因模型来制作既具有照片现实性又忠实于输入性的细节是具有挑战性的. 我们提出SuperSharpen,一种基于扩散的盲调方法,通过模糊的测量来明确控制恢复强度。 我们比较了两种调节策略:一个冷冻骨干上的ControlNet式适配器,以及前期扩散的完全微调. 我们的实验显示,微调能用更少的幻觉细节实现更好的忠诚. 我们验证了我们对合成和现实世界采取的方法模糊不清,显示出观念质量的提高和可控制的恢复力。

articles.title: Can Coding Agents Build Robust Baselines? A Skill-Based Approach for Automating the Medical Imaging Model-Development Pipeline
articles.content: Developing competitive deep learning baselines for medical imaging remains a highly iterative process requiring literature review, implementation, experimentation, and expert refinement. Existing automation approaches typically optimize isolated components, such as architecture search or hyperparameter tuning, rather than the complete baseline development process. We present an agentic AI Scientist workflow that combines literature-guided reasoning, automated code generation, and hypothesis-driven experimentation to generate competitive baseline models for medical imaging challenges. The framework is evaluated on four public benchmarks spanning segmentation, classification, and detection. Across all tasks, the Experimentation Pipeline consistently improves validation performance, achieving competitive leaderboard results, including 6th place on both PUMA tracks (15 teams) and 31st place on MILK10k (125 teams). On MIDOG25, the resulting model also demonstrates strong domain generalization across scanners, tumor types, and species. Using the same workflow across all challenges without task-specific redesign, we demonstrate that skill-based, literature-guided agentic workflows can substantially reduce the engineering effort required to develop competitive medical imaging baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 编码代理能够构建强大的基线吗 ? 以技能为基础的医疗成像模型-发展管道自动化方法
articles.content_zh: 制定具有竞争力的医学成像深层学习基线仍然是一个高度迭代的过程,需要文献审查、执行、实验和专家的完善。 现有的自动化方法一般优化孤立组件,如架构搜索或超参数调试,而不是完整的基线开发过程. 我们提出了一个代理AI科学家工作流程,该流程结合了文献指导推理,自动化代码生成,以及假说驱动的实验,为医学成像挑战生成竞争性基准模型. 该框架按划分、分类和检测这四个公共基准进行评估。 在所有任务中,实验管道都不断提高验证性能,实现有竞争力的领导板结果,包括PUMA两轨(15支队伍)排名第6位,MILK10k(125支队伍)排名第31位. 在MIDOG25上,所产生的模型还显示,在扫描仪、肿瘤类型和物种中,域域的普及程度很强。 我们利用相同的工作流程,处理所有挑战,而不针对具体任务的重新设计,表明基于技能的、以文献为指南的代理工作流程可以大大减少开发具有竞争力的医学成像基线所需的工程工作。

articles.title: IntentQA: Intent Question Answering in Videos by Cognitive Context Reasoning
articles.content: Video understanding requires intelligent agents to transcend mere recognition of visual facts and comprehend the underlying intents behind human actions (often termed the "dark matter" of social intelligence). To bridge the gap between visual observation and intent reasoning, we introduce a novel task, IntentQA, and contribute a large-scale VideoQA dataset specifically tailored for this purpose. However, recognizing that standard metrics may overestimate capabilities due to dataset biases, we go beyond simple accuracy to rigorously evaluate model robustness. We augment the benchmark by generating five distinct contrast sets via Large Language Models (LLMs) and introducing a "Contrast Performance Decline" metric. We propose the X-CaVIR (eXplainable Context-aware Video Intent Reasoning) framework, which leverages three types of "Cognitive Context" to enhance video analysis: i) Situational Context via a cross-modal Video Query Language (VQL) module, ii) Contrastive Context via a Contrastive Learning module, and iii) Commonsense Context via a Commonsense Reasoning module. Crucially, to overcome the opacity of traditional black-box models, we refine the integration of LLMs within X-CaVIR by employing a transparent pipeline that synergizes video captions with VQA model outputs. This approach not only improves performance by effectively utilizing rich commonsense knowledge but also renders the reasoning process explicitly interpretable. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our components, the superiority of X-CaVIR over state-of-the-art baselines, and its stability against perturbations on the contrast sets.

articles.title_zh: 意向QA:意向问题通过认知背景在视频中解答
articles.content_zh: 视频理解要求智能特工超越单纯的视觉事实识别,并理解人类行动背后的基本意图(常被称作"社会智能的"暗物质"). 为了弥合视觉观察和意向推理之间的差距,我们引入了一个新任务"IntentQA",并贡献了一个专门为此设计的大规模VideoQA数据集. 然而,我们认识到,标准衡量标准可能由于数据集偏差而高估能力,因此我们超越了简单的准确度,严格评价模型的稳健性。 我们通过大语言模型(LLMS)生成出五套不同的对比度,并引入了"复合性能下降"(Contrast Performance Dreague)的度量衡,来增强基准. 我们提出"X-CaVIR"(可解释的上下文-意识视频意向推理)框架,利用"认知背景"三种类型加强视频分析: (一)通过跨模式视频查询语言(VQL)模块的情景背景, (二)通过对比学习模块的矛盾背景, (三)通过常识推理模块的常识背景. 关键是,为了克服传统黑盒模型的不透明性,我们通过使用透明管线将视频字幕与VQA模型输出协同,来完善LLMs在X-CaVIR中的整合. 这种做法不仅通过有效利用丰富的常识知识提高了绩效,而且使推理过程可以明确解释。 广泛的实验表明我们的部件是有效的,X-CaVIR优于最先进的基线,并且其稳定性能防止对比套上的扰动.

articles.title: Thinking Beyond Videos: Unifying Video Reasoning and Deep Research for Open-World Video Agents
articles.content: Open-world video understanding often requires a model to locate sparse visual evidence and acquire external knowledge that is absent from the video and its parametric memory. While Thinking-with-Videos enables active temporal perception and Deep Research supports multi-step information seeking, the two capabilities are typically developed in isolation. We introduce VideoRover, a unified Video Deep Research framework that iteratively coordinates video cropping, multimodal search, and webpage browsing. Given a video-question pair, VideoRover uses each tool result to select the next action, so localized video clips guide external retrieval and retrieved evidence triggers further video inspection and verification. To develop this capability, we construct an automated data curation pipeline, producing 26K verified SFT trajectories and 3K challenging RL instances. We also introduce VideoRover-Bench, a benchmark stratified by video duration and research difficulty. Experiments on VideoDR and VideoRover-Bench show that our VideoRover-8B-RL achieves performance comparable to proprietary models in the direct-answer setting without tool use while outperforming larger open-source models equipped with the same tool suite. Ablation studies and training dynamics further validate the complementary roles of active video grounding, external retrieval, and long-horizon reinforcement learning.

articles.title_zh: 《超越视频的思考:为开放世界视频代理商统一视频理性和深度研究》
articles.content_zh: 开放世界的视频理解往往需要一种模型来定位稀少的视觉证据并获得视频及其参数记忆所缺少的外部知识. 虽然 " 与视频思维 " 能够使时间感知活跃,而 " 深度研究 " 则支持多步骤信息搜索,但这两种能力通常是孤立地发展起来的。 我们引入了VideoRover, 一个统一的Video Deep Research框架, 迭代协调视频裁剪、多模式搜索和网页浏览。 由于一个视频-问题对接,VideoRover使用每个结果选择下一个动作,因此本地化的视频片段引导外部检索和取回的证据触发了进一步的视频检查和验证. 为了发展这一能力,我们建造了自动数据校正管道,生产了26K个经核实的SFT轨迹和3K个挑战性RL实例。 我们还引入了VideoRover-Bench,这是按视频持续时间和研究难度划分的基准. 在VideoRDR和VideoRover-Bench上的实验显示,我们的VideoRover-8B-RL在不使用工具的直答设置中实现了与专有模型相仿的性能,同时在装有同一套工具套件的较大开源模型上表现优于专有模型. 校正研究与培训动态进一步验证了主动视频地取地,外取地取地,长视强化学习等互补作用.

articles.title: Grounding Free-Form Instructions for Fashion Complementary Image Generation
articles.content: Fashion complementary image generation (CIG) aims to create garments that stylistically match a seed item based on user intent, making it a natural multimodal grounding problem where models must interpret language in visual context. Existing CIG benchmarks rely on rigid template prompts (e.g., "a photo of a skirt"), failing to reflect natural user queries and obscuring model behavior across levels of linguistic specificity. We introduce fashion complementary image generation with free-form instructions, a multimodal language-grounding setting where a model generates a compatible garment from a seed image and a natural-language instruction. To this end, we enrich three CIG benchmarks with low-, medium-, and high-specificity instructions generated by a vision-language model and validated by human annotators. We instantiate the task with StyleFlow, a Rectified Flow Matching model that jointly conditions on the seed image and instruction within a single multimodal transformer. Across image quality metrics, catalog-alignment analysis, ablations, and human evaluation, StyleFlow consistently produces instruction-aligned and stylistically coherent garments while reducing architectural complexity and inference cost relative to auxiliary-module approaches.

articles.title_zh: 为时尚补充图像生成设定免费格式指令
articles.content_zh: 时尚互补图像生成(CIG)旨在以用户意图为基础,创造出与种子项目结构相匹配的服装,使其成为一个自然的多模式地基问题,模型必须在视觉上下文中解释语言. 现有的CIG基准依赖于刚性模板提示(如"裙相"),未能反映自然用户的询问并模糊跨语言特异性层次的模型行为. 我们引入了时尚互补图像生成,带有自由格式指令,一种多模式语言定位设置,一个模型从种子图像和自然语言指令中生成相容的服装. 为此,我们用由视觉语言模型生成并经过人文注释者验证的低,中,高特异性指示来丰富了三个CIG基准. 我们用StyleFlow(一种经过校正的相配流模型)来即时处理任务,该模型在一个单一多式变压器内共同对种子图像和指令设置条件。 在图像质量衡量标准、编目协调分析、编目和人的评价中,StyleFlow一贯制作与教学相匹配和有型相通的服装,同时降低建筑复杂性和与辅助模块方法相适应的推论成本。

articles.title: What Remains Normal? Clean Images Miss Useful Near-Defect Normal Patches for Anomaly Detection
articles.content: Memory-based anomaly detectors store nominal training patches and score test patches against this memory. A patch selected for coverage therefore becomes a nor- mal reference without a separate check that geometric rarity makes it safe to trust. We probe this coupling with sparse training contamination. Under fixed representa- tions and memory budgets, we compare random, medoid, local, and global coverage selectors. We then use CLEANCON, an out-of-bag cross-image support gate that changes candidate-image eligibility while fixing the representation, absolute mem- ory size, builder, and inference rule. Global coverage strongly over-represents sparse contamination. CLEANCON reduces final-memory contamination to approx- imately zero and increases category-macro P-AP in all 12 matched comparisons. Yet along a retention sweep, the lowest-contamination memory does not attain the highest P-AP; performance continues to improve while contamination rises. Mem- ory contamination therefore does not order the resulting memories by P-AP.Code is publicly available at https://github.com/jw-chae/cleancon.

articles.title: Spotter: Efficient Urban Visual Localization via Geo-Referenced Facade Landmarks in GPS-Degraded Environments
articles.content: Accurate visual localization on robotic and wearable platforms remains challenging in dense urban environments. Existing methodologies typically rely on GPS for absolute positioning, yet GPS signals frequently degrade in urban canyons due to multipath propagation. Consequently, standard solutions like visual odometry suffer from unmitigated drift over time, while map-matching techniques struggle to acquire the reliable GPS priors they need, on top of being too computationally heavy for real-time edge execution. To address these limitations, we propose Spotter, a robuts and real-time visual localization framework that uses building facades as a reliable source of global geo-reference, while retaining the capability to integrate GPS signals when available. In an offline stage, Spotter processes Google Street View panoramas by semantically segmenting facades and pairing multi-view stereo depth with cartographic data to build a compact metric database. At runtime, query images are matched via a cascaded retrieval and geometric verification pipeline to recover fine-grained global camera localization. We benchmark Spotter on a newly collected dataset of pedestrian sequences acquired with wearable smart glasses across several districts of Barcelona. Experimental results show that Spotter outperforms odometry-based baselines and achieves localization accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art map-based methods while operating at significantly higher frame rates.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Spotter:通过GPS-降级环境中的地标地标实现高效的城市视觉本地化
articles.content_zh: 在密集的城市环境中,在机器人和可穿戴的平台上准确的视觉本地化仍然具有挑战性。 现有方法通常依靠全球定位系统进行绝对定位,然而,由于多路径传播,全球定位系统信号在城市峡谷中往往会退化。 因此,目视等标准溶液随时间推移而出现无法缓解的漂移,而地图比对技术则难以获得它们所需要的可靠的GPS前身,此外在计算上过于沉重,无法进行实时边缘执行. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议Spotter,一个robuts和实时视觉本地化框架,利用建筑外观作为可靠的全球地理参考来源,同时保留在有GPS信号时进行集成的能力. 在离线阶段,Spotter通过精密地分解外观来处理Google Street View全景,并将多景立体深度与制图数据配对,以建立一个紧凑的度量数据库. 在运行时,查询图像通过级联检索和几何校正管道进行匹配,以恢复精细的全球相机本地化. 我们以一套新收集的可穿戴的智能眼镜获得的行人序列数据集作为Spotter的基准。 实验结果显示,"Spotter"的性能超过了基于odometer的基线,并实现了能与最先进的基于地图的方法相媲美的本地化精度,同时以显著更高的帧率运行.

articles.title: Spatiotemporally Decoupled Autoregressive Diffusion Model for Human Motion Generation
articles.content: Text-driven human motion synthesis has made substantial development with two core modules of motion representation and generative architecture. For representation, Vector Quantization (VQ)-based methods compress motion data into discrete tokens while latent-based models operate directly in continuous space. However, both of these representations exhibit significant limitations. VQ-based methods suffer from inherent information loss, which compromises the quality, diversity, and generalization of generated motions, while continuous representation on holistic whole-body motion hinders part-level flexibility. For architecture, diffusion and autoregressive diffusion models have demonstrated their superiority, yet the fine-grained controllability over individual body parts is also limited. Thus, we propose a unified spatiotemporally decoupled framework named DeMoDiff, which jointly redesigns representation and architecture. To enhance representation extraction capabilities and offer greater part-level controllability, we present a spatial-temporal VAE that encodes each body joint rather than compressing the whole-body motion into a single latent space. Then, we incorporate spatial-temporal masking and attention mechanisms into an autoregressive diffusion generator, achieving both generative capability and controllable editability. Extensive experiments on the HumanML3D and KIT-ML datasets demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance and compelling motion generation results. Moreover, our framework demonstrates strong temporal and spatial editing capabilities, further validating its effectiveness. Our project page: https://rex0191.github.io/DeMoDiff/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Spatiotemporally 解除了人类运动的自旋扩散模型
articles.content_zh: 由文字驱动的人类运动合成,有了运动表现和基因结构两个核心模块,取得了实质性的发展. 对于表现,以矢量量化(VQ)为基础的方法将运动数据压缩成离散的符号,而以潜在为基础的模型则直接在连续空间中运行. 然而,这两项陈述都显示出了重大的局限性。 基于VQ的方法受到内在信息损失的影响,这损害了生成的运动的质量、多样性和概括性,而持续代表整体整体运动则会阻碍部分层面的灵活性。 对于建筑来说,扩散和自递式扩散模型已经显示出其优越性,然而对单个身体部位的精细可控性也是有限的. 因此,我们提议建立一个名为DeMoDiff的统一临时脱钩框架,共同重新设计代表性和结构。 为了增强代表提取能力,并提供更大的分级可控性,我们提出了空间-时相VAE,将每个机体联动编码,而不是将整个机体运动压缩成一个单一的潜在空间. 然后,我们把空间时空遮盖和注意机制纳入自相递增的传播生成器,实现基因能力和可控制的可编辑性。 对HumanML3D和KIT-ML数据集的广泛实验表明,我们的模型实现了最先进的重建性能和令人信服的运动生成结果. 此外,我们的框架显示出强大的时间和空间编辑能力,进一步验证了其有效性。 我们的项目网页:https://rex0191.github.io/DeMoDiff/

articles.title: Dual-Grained Agent Memory and Shapley Context Attribution for Multimodal Agentic Learner
articles.content: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) deliver impressive perception yet still falter on scientific and mathematical reasoning. Parameter-level adaptation is unavailable for closed-weight or on-device backbones, and stateless prompting forfeits any compounding benefit from problems already solved. We propose \textbf{DG-Mem}, a dual-grained agentic memory framework that augments a frozen MLLM with a non-parametric, externally stored memory built once from training-time rollouts and consulted read-only at test time. Motivated by the Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) account of human memory, DG-Mem factors its store into an instance-grounded exemplar memory and a category-level schema memory of IF-THEN rules, with a transient reflection store mediating their construction so that schemas are synthesized only from abstract reflections, never from exemplar text. Two design choices distinguish DG-Mem: an online concept categorizer that grows the category space incrementally during training rather than committing to a predefined taxonomy, and a Shapley context attribution procedure that decomposes correctness across the entire retrieved rule set and yields a per-rule utility that re-weights retrieval at test time. The pipeline introduces no gradient updates and is deployable on closed-weight or on-device backbones. Across MathVista, MMMU, and MMMU-Pro on four open-weight and proprietary backbones (Qwen3.5-27B, Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, GPT-5-Nano, Gemini-3-Flash), DG-Mem improves consistently over no-memory and competitive memory baselines.

articles.title_zh: 为多式代理学习者提供双格代理内存和上下文
articles.content_zh: 前沿多模式大型语言模型(MLLMs)提供了令人印象深刻的感知,但在科学和数学推理方面仍然步履维艰。 封闭式或站台式主干线没有参数级的适应能力,无国籍者导致丧失已经解决的问题所带来的任何复合利益。 我们提议\textbf{DG-Mem},一种双加成剂内存框架,用一个非参数化的外部存储内存来增强被冻结的MLLM,这种内存是一次从训练时间的推出中建立起来的,并在测试时间只读一次。 受"补充学习系统"(CLS)对人类记忆的描述所激发,DG-Mem将它的存储因素推入了实例化的示例存储器和IF-THEN规则的分类层次的存储器,由一瞬间反射存储器来调解它们的构造,使schemas只从抽象的反射来合成,从来不从实例文本来合成. 两种设计选择区分了DG-Mem:一种在线概念分类器,在训练期间逐渐地增加类别空间,而不是致力于预先定义的分类学;另一种是Shapley上下文归属程序,将整个被检索的规则集的正确性分解,并产生每个规则的效用,在测试时重新加权检索. 输油管没有进行梯度更新,可被安装在封闭式或设备上的主干道上。 在MathVista、MMMU和MMU-Pro的4个开放重量和专有骨干上(Quen3.5-27B、Quen3.5-122B-A10B、GPT-5-Nano、双子座-3-Flash),DG-Mem在无记忆和竞争性记忆基线上不断改进。

articles.title: Progressively Learning Heterogeneous Skills in a Unified Latent Space
articles.content: We propose HetSkills, a novel framework designed to progressively learn heterogeneous skills within a unified latent space for physics-based character control. The core idea is to treat this latent space as a shared executable interface, enabling seamless integration of skills learned from diverse data sources, supervision forms, and tasks. HetSkills begins by learning a tracking skill that establishes a strong foundation in motion control and creates a shared motion decoder, which can be reused across tasks without the need for retraining or separate controllers. To prevent the text-to-motion skill from exploiting shortcut pathways instead of learning language semantics, we introduce motion intuition distillation to ground text-to-motion generation in language semantics and a task-guidance module that dynamically adjusts actions based on high-level language instructions. This enables HetSkills to preserve natural motion while continuously expanding its skill repertoire, making it highly adaptable for long-horizon tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness in motion tracking, text-to-motion generation, motion completion, and downstream task adaptation, achieving impressive success rates even under challenging conditions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在统一的后期空间逐步学习异质技能
articles.content_zh: 我们提出HetSkills,这个新颖的框架,旨在在一个统一的基于物理的字符控制潜在空间中,逐步学习各种技能。 核心思想是将这一潜在的空间作为共享可执行界面,使从各种数据来源、监督形式和任务中学到的技能能够无缝地融合。 HetSkills开始学习一种跟踪技能,这种技能在运动控制上建立了牢固的基础并创建了共享的运动解码器,可以跨任务再用而无需再培训或单独控制器. 为了防止文字到运动技巧利用快捷路径而不是学习语言语义,我们在语言语义中引入了将运动直觉分馏到地面的文字到运动生成,以及基于高层次语言指令的动态调整动作的任务指导模块. 这使得HetSkills能够保持自然运动,同时不断扩展其技能回放,使其高度适应长视任务. 实验结果表明,即使在挑战性条件下,在运动跟踪、文字到运动生成、运动完成和下游任务适应方面都取得了令人印象深刻的成功率。

articles.title: E2S-Pruner: Progressive Two-Stage Evidence Fusion for Visual Token Pruning in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Vision-language models typically encode an image into hundreds of visual tokens, incurring substantial inference latency and GPU memory overhead. Existing pruning methods largely rely on attention scores and directly aggregate outputs across attention heads and network layers, making it difficult to characterize evidential uncertainty and conflict. We propose E2S-Pruner, a progressive two-stage evidence-fusion framework for visual token pruning that requires no auxiliary model, trainable parameters, or fine-tuning. In the first stage, E2S-Pruner treats each attention head as an independent evidence source, estimates its reliability from evidence clarity and inter-head consistency, and represents each visual token using three states: important, unimportant, and uncertain. In the second stage, Dempster--Shafer evidence theory is used to quantify inter-layer conflict and fuse complementary evidence from multiple network layers. We further introduce a spatial novelty constraint that promotes coverage of distinct image regions and prevents the retained tokens from concentrating in a few locally salient areas. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, E2S-Pruner retains 98.0%, 96.8%, and 90.6% of the aggregate performance when the average numbers of retained visual tokens are 192, 128, and 64, respectively, while improving throughput by 1.96x and 2.09x under the 128-token and 64-token settings. Experiments on Qwen2-VL-7B further demonstrate cross-model generalization. Code is available at https://github.com/taoyu-qian/E2S-Pruner.git.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: E2S- Pruner:视觉Token Pruning在视觉-语言模型中的进取双阶证据融合
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型一般会将一幅图像编码成上百个可视符号,从而引起大量的推论后置和GPU内存高架. 现有的打分方法主要依靠注意力分数和直接汇总各注意力头和网络层的产出,因此难以定性证据不确定性和冲突。 我们提出E2S-Pruner, 一个渐进的两阶段证据集合框架, 用于视觉信号的打压, 不需要辅助模型,可训练参数, 或微调。 在第一阶段,E2S-Pruner将每个关注头作为一个独立的证据来源,从证据的清晰度和头与头之间的一致性来估计它的可靠性,并用三个状态代表每个视觉符号:重要,不重要,不确定. 在第二阶段,Dempster-Shafer证据理论用于量化层间冲突并从多层网络中将补充证据进行分解. 我们进一步引入了空间新颖的限制因素,促进覆盖不同的图像区域,并阻止保留的迹象集中在几个当地显著地区。 在LLaVA-1.5-7B上,E2S-Pruner保留了98.0%,96.8%和90.6%的总性能,当所保留的视觉标志的平均数量分别为192个,128个和64个,同时在128个托肯和64个托肯设置下提高了1.96x和2.09x的吞吐量. 在Qwen2-VL-7B上的实验进一步展示了跨模型通论. 代码可见于https://github.com/taoyu-qian/E2S-Pruner.git.

articles.title: Semantic Reconstruction and 3-D Detection via Learned Multi-Pair Fusion in RF Imaging
articles.content: We consider a multistatic radio-frequency imaging problem with anisotropy, in which the reflection from a point depends on the positions of the transmit (Tx) and receive (Rx) arrays. The goal is to label the voxels of a field of view by a finite set of semantic classes and to group them into object instances. For the image formation of each Tx--Rx pair we apply a standard inverse-problem solver, and we feed the resulting per-pair reconstructions into a trained three-dimensional (3-D) U-Net that performs the fusion implicitly and the per-voxel classification explicitly. On a controlled, under-determined multistatic setup, we consider the following image formation methods: back-projection (BP) and the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) from a single deterministic snapshot, and incoherent BP and group-LASSO from multiple fading snapshots. For each imaging method we train a separate U-Net that fuses the six Tx--Rx pairs (its input channels) and assigns each voxel a probability vector over the classes. Taking the most probable class gives a labeled volume---the semantic reconstruction. Object instances and their oriented bounding boxes then follow by geometric post-processing (clustering and principal-component analysis). Across a wide range of signal-to-noise ratio, the semantic reconstruction (scored against ground truth by segmentation intersection-over-union) and the resulting 3-D detection degrade far more gracefully than the classical intensity reconstruction: the detection in particular stays reliable well into noise levels at which that reconstruction has dissolved. Because real scenes contain objects of classes the network was not trained on, we add an explicit unknown class trained by outlier exposure, which labels held-out novel objects as unknown instead of mislabeling them as a known class by reconstructed shape.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过在RF成像中学习到的多平面组合进行语义重建和三维检测
articles.content_zh: 我们认为一个与同位素相异的多静态射频成像问题,其中从一个点的反射取决于发射(Tx)和接收(Rx)阵列的位置. 目标是用一组有限的语义类来标记一个视域的花纹并把它们组合成对象实例. 对于每个Tx-Rx对的图像形成,我们应用一个标准反向问题解析器,我们把由此产生的每平面重建输入一个训练有素的三维(3-D)U-Net,以隐含的方式进行聚变,并明确进行每伏克塞尔分级. 在受控,定义不足的多静态设置上,我们考虑以下的图像形成方法:后投影(BP)和最小的绝对收缩和选择操作员(LASSO)从单一的决定性快照中取出,从多个被淡出快照中取出不一致的BP和Group-LASO. 对于每一种成像方法,我们训练一个单独的U-Net,将6个Tx-Rx对(其输入通道)引信,并指定每个Voxel一个概率矢量超过各类。 取出最有可能的分类 就会得到标注的音量 语义重建 然后进行几何后处理(分组和主组件分析)。 在广泛的信号-噪声比中,语义重建(通过分解相接而与地面真理相对分)和由此产生的3-D探测比古典强度重建更优雅地降解:探测尤其保持了可靠的噪声水平,而重建已经解体。 因为真实的场景中包含了网络没有训练的课对象,所以我们增加了一个通过外出曝光训练的显性未知课,它把被搁置出的新事物标为未知,而不是通过被重建的形状将其误标为已知的课.

articles.title: Mover360: Controllable Object Manipulation in 360° Panoramic Images
articles.content: We present Mover360, a controllable object manipulation framework for 360° images. Unlike perspective images, 360° images in equirectangular projection (ERP) exhibit horizontal wrap-around, latitude-dependent distortion, and global scene continuity, which makes object-level edits difficult for existing perspective editors to produce and for users to specify. To address this, Mover360 centers on object Translation (relocating a specified object within an existing panorama) while supporting reference-guided Insert and Remove as auxiliary tasks. Its interface unifies point-, bbox-, and mask-guided control by encoding each task into a fixed prompt and a compact, ERP-aligned instruction map. In the default point mode, a single click relocates an object, allowing the model to infer a plausible size, support, and illumination using panoramic context and an auxiliary depth condition. Structurally, Mover360 is a lightweight adaptation of a pretrained diffusion transformer. To generate paired supervision, we construct a UE5 data-generation pipeline with surface-aware object placement and randomized illumination, yielding large-scale paired data and a dual-domain benchmark of synthetic and real panoramas with ground truth for all three tasks. Across both test domains and two evaluation protocols, Mover360 outperforms strong baselines for perspective editing, insertion, and inpainting in reconstruction fidelity, semantic consistency, and distributional quality. Code and our benchmark dataset are available at https://zhonghaoyi.github.io/Mover360/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Morr360:360°全景图像中可控对象操纵
articles.content_zh: 我们提出Morr360,一个360°图像的可控对象操纵框架. 与视角图像不同,正方形投影(ERP)中360°的图像呈现出横向的环绕,以纬度为依存的扭曲,以及全局场景的连续性,这使得已存在的视角编辑器和用户难以进行对象级编辑. 为了解决这个问题,Mover360在对象翻译(在现有全景内调整指定对象)上居中,同时支持参考指针插入并删除作为辅助任务. 它的接口统一了点-bbox-和口罩制导控制,将每个任务编码为固定的即时和紧凑的ERP相通指令地图. 在默认点模式下,一次点击可以移动一个对象,使模型可以使用全景上下文和辅助深度条件推断出一个似是而非的大小,支持和发光. 在结构上,Mover360是先受训练的扩散变压器的一种轻量级改造. 为了产生配对监督,我们建造了UE5数据生成管道,采用地表感知物体定位和随机照明,产生大规模配对数据和合成和真实全景双域基准,所有三项任务都具有地面真实性。 Morr360在两个测试领域和两个评价协议中,都超越了对视角编辑、插入和再造忠心、语义一致性和分布质量的有力基线。 代码和我们的基准数据集见https://zhonghaoyi.github.io/Mover360/。

articles.title: MLLM-Assisted Audio VOS: A 3rd Place Report for the MeViS-Audio Track, 8th LSVOS Challenge
articles.content: In this technical report, we present a training-free framework for audio-guided video object segmentation, which integrates Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) with SAM-based segmentation models. We decompose the task into several stages and identify suitable foundation models for each stage. Without introducing additional model training or task-specific fine-tuning, our approach leverages the strong multimodal reasoning capabilities of MLLMs to model text-visual correspondence and employs SAM-based models for accurate object mask generation. The proposed framework demonstrates the effectiveness of leveraging foundation models for audio-guided video segmentation and achieves competitive performance in the MeViS-Audio Track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MLLM-Assisted Audio VOS: MeViS-Audio Track 第3地段报告, 第8个LSVOS挑战
articles.content_zh: 在这份技术报告中,我们提出了无培训的音频制导视频物体分解框架,该框架将多式大语言模型(MLLMs)与基于SAM的分解模型相融合. 我们把任务分为几个阶段,并为每个阶段确定适当的基础模型。 我们的方法没有引入额外的模型培训或针对特定任务的微调,而是利用MLLMs强大的多模式推理能力来建模文本-视觉通信,并使用基于SAM的模型来准确生成对象口罩. 拟议框架展示了利用基础模型进行音频制导视频分解的有效性,并在第八届LSVOS挑战赛的MeViS-Audio Track中实现了竞争性能.

articles.title: Think Only When Needed: Prompt-Authority Control for Selective Slow-Path Intervention in Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
articles.content: Retrieval can efficiently and effectively augment a frozen vision--language--action (VLA) policy without retraining, yet retrieved text becomes a control intervention once it enters the executed prompt. In a matched audit, raw appended text reduces mean success from 92.47\% to 3.00\%, while meaningful and length-matched meaningless appends both fail on all 500 states. This result identifies \emph{prompt-form collapse}: changing the instruction form, rather than adding useful semantics, can dominate execution. We introduce TOWN-VLA (Think Only When Needed), a prompt-authority interface that separates candidate generation from permission to alter the policy input. A fixed compatibility rule authorizes a canonical compact instruction; otherwise, the interface restores the original Base prompt exactly. Across 900 audited routes, every route follows this contract: 525 routes recover Base with matching hashes, and all 375 authorized prompts preserve the task signature. On a matched $4\times7$ LIBERO-Plus evaluation with 10{,}030 episodes per method, success rises from 69.5\% to 73.1\% ($+362$ episodes; 95\% CI 1.89--5.45 points), improving on six perturbation axes and all four suites. On a physical PiPER arm with a frozen \pizerofive{} checkpoint, success rises from 52.7\% to 78.7\% over 150 trials per method ($p=3.16\times10^{-6}$). Prompt authority is enforceable for a frozen controller; oracle-free admission calibration is the next deployment target.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 仅在需要时才思考:在视觉-语言-操作操作中进行选择性慢派干预的快速授权控制
articles.content_zh: 检索可以切实有效地加强冻结的视觉-语言-行动(VLA)政策,而不进行再培训,但检索的文本一旦进入被执行的即成为控制干预. 在匹配的审计中,原始的附录文本将成功率从92.47\%降至3.00\%;而有意义的和长相匹配的无意义附录则在所有500个州都失败了。 这个结果识别出\emph{ prompt-form 崩溃}: 改变指令形式,而不是添加有用的语义,可以支配执行. 我们引入了TONWN-VLA(只考虑何时需要),即时授权接口,将候选一代与改变政策投入的许可区分开来. 一个固定相容性规则授权一个Canonic Concess 指令;否则,接口会完全恢复原来的 Base 提示. 在900条经审计的路线中,每条路线都遵循这一合同:525条路线以相匹配的散列方式收复了基地,所有375个经授权的提示都保留了任务签名. 在4美元Times7美元LIBERO-Plus的评价中,每套方法有10{,}030集,成功率从69.5\%升至73.1\%(+362$;95\%CI 1.89-5.45分),在6个扰动轴和所有4个套房上都有改善. 在一个装有被冻结的\pizero5\}检查站的PiPER手臂上,成功率从52.7\\\\\\\\\\\到78.7\\\\\\\\,每方法超过150次审判(p=3.16\times10\\\\==$)。 对被冻结的管制员可执行即时授权;无甲骨文的准入校正是下一个部署目标。

articles.title: BenthicDINO: Physics-Informed Self-Distillation for View-Invariant Side-Scan Sonar Representations
articles.content: Automated perception in side-scan sonar (SSS) imagery is severely hindered by physical acoustic artifacts, resulting in representations that inextricably mix intrinsic seabed reflectivity with transient viewing geometries. Existing self-supervised learning (SSL) frameworks rely on augmentations designed for natural images, failing to account for acoustic degradation and explicitly enforce view-invariance. To address this gap, we introduce a physics-informed self-distillation framework built upon the DINOv3 architecture utilizing a ConvNeXt-v2-Tiny backbone to maximize data efficiency. The proposed methodology enforces view-invariance through two primary mechanisms: physically motivated augmentations that simulate speckle noise, range-dependent attenuation, and radiometric miscalibration; and a Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) penalty that explicitly decouples learned dense patch features from physical viewing parameters. Furthermore, we propose a dense, hierarchical feature fusion strategy across all four network stages to preserve fine-grained sediment details alongside deep semantic abstractions. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that the framework natively groups complex benthic topographies into stable, noise-free semantic clusters without relying on manual annotations. During supervised downstream tasks on the S3Seg dataset, the fused representations exhibited exceptional data efficiency, achieving 96% of its absolute peak performance using only 10% of the available annotated data, ultimately reaching a mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) of 71.4% and an overall accuracy of 86.5%.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BenthicDINO:用于视图的物理-成形自旋-Invariant Side-Scan Sonar Presentations
articles.content_zh: 外侧扫描声纳图像中的自动感知被物理声学文物所严重地阻碍,导致其表现方式将内在的海底反射率与瞬时取景地貌混合在一起。 现有的自监督学习(SSL)框架依赖于为自然图像所设计的增强功能,未能说明声学退化的原因并明确执行取景偏差. 为了弥补这一差距,我们采用了一个基于DINOv3架构的物理学知情自沉框架,利用ConvNEXt-v2-Tiny主干网,以最大限度地提高数据效率。 拟议的方法通过两种主要机制强制执行视图变化:模拟光谱噪声的物理动力增强、依赖射程的减弱和辐射测量误差;以及Hilbert-Schmidt Independent Criterion(HSIC)的判罚,明确从物理取景参数中解析出密集的补丁特征。 此外,我们建议在所有四个网络阶段采取密集、分级的地貌聚变战略,以保留精细的沉积物细节以及深层语义抽象。 广泛的评价表明,框架将复杂的海底地貌编组成稳定、无噪声的语义集群,而不依赖人工说明。 在S3Seg数据集的下游监督任务期间,引信显示的数据效率超乎寻常,只使用10%的现有附加说明数据,实现了96%的绝对峰值性能,最终在联盟上空达到71.4%的中间截面,总体准确度为86.5%。

articles.title: Bee Detection and Tracking at Hive Entrance using YOLO11 and ByteTrack
articles.content: This work presents an automatic bee entrance monitoring system based on YOLO11 transfer learning and the ByteTrack tracking algorithm. The study investigates the influence of data augmentation, backbone freezing, and tracker parameter optimization on the detection and counting of small, fast-moving bees. The detector with progressive backbone unfreezing strategy achieved about 97.0% precision and 98.7% mAP50, while providing more stable convergence than full fine-tuning. Experiments also showed that light augmentation outperformed heavy augmentation. For tracking, ByteTrack parameters were optimized to improve trajectory continuity under low-confidence detections. On an independent 25 FPS side-view video, the optimized YOLO11-ByteTrack system correctly counted 43 of 47 incoming bees (91.5%) and 7 of 30 outgoing bees (23.3%). Error analysis showed that most counting errors were caused by missed detections due to rapid bee motion and motion blur, while tracking failures became less frequent after parameter optimization. Overall, the results indicate that moderate augmentation, progressive backbone unfreezing, and ByteTrack tuning improve the reliability of automatic bee entrance monitoring under realistic recording conditions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 蜂窝入口使用YOLO11和字节跟踪
articles.content_zh: 这项工作提出了基于YOLO11转移学习和ByteTrack跟踪算法的自动蜂入门监测系统. 研究调查了数据增强,骨干冻结,跟踪参数优化对小而快动的蜜蜂检测和计数的影响. 采用渐进式骨干解冻策略的探测器实现了约97.0%的精度和98.7%的mAP50,同时提供了比全微调更稳定的趋同. 实验还表明,轻增能超过重增能. 在追踪方面,优化了ByteTrack参数,以便在低信心探测下改善轨迹连续性. 在独立的25个FPS侧视视频上,被优化的YOLO11-ByteTrack系统正确计算出47个入门蜜蜂中的43个(91.5%)和30个出道蜜蜂中的7个(23.3%). 出错分析显示,大多数计数出错都是由快速蜜蜂运动和运动模糊而导致的检测缺失而来,而跟踪故障在参数优化后变得不那么频繁. 总体而言,结果表明,适度增强、渐进骨干解冻和ByteTrack调制提高了在现实记录条件下自动蜂入室监测的可靠性。

articles.title: Learning Spherical Occupancy Profiles for Multi-View 3D Reconstruction and Generation
articles.content: We study spherical occupancy profiles-the ray-wise occupancy probability profiles P(r) = T(r) o(r) distilled from multi-view 3D Gaussian reconstructions-as a unified intermediate representation for both discriminative and generative 3D reconstruction from images. On a 999-object subset of Google Scanned Objects with 48 turntable views each, we train (i) a discriminative per-ray decoder that injects global view-averaged and ray-specific image evidence into a FiLM-conditioned profile head, reaching median soft depth error 0.035 (normalized) on an independent 90-object test split, and (ii) a generative pipeline built on a profile VAE and a latent diffusion model, which supports unconditional sampling that matches the reconstruction manifold and image-conditioned multi-solution reconstruction whose per-object solution spread is quantifiable and tunable via classifier-free guidance. We further analyze the morphology of predicted profiles: post-hoc power sharpening and a learned sharpening target both recover ground-truth profile width without degrading depth, exposing a monotonic width-peak frontier in the L1-per-ray loss family and motivating a principled redefinition of morphology gates. Real-photo validation on two DTU scenes confirms the pipeline transfers to non-synthetic input. Our results suggest that ray-wise occupancy profiles offer a compact, learned, and uncertainty-aware interface between multi-view reconstruction and generative priors.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多维三维重建与生成学习球面占用简介
articles.content_zh: 我们研究球形入住情况简介-射线入住概率简介 P(r) = T(r) o(r) 从多视图3D高斯重建中提炼出来,作为从图像中分化和基因3D重建的统一中间代表. 在Google扫描对象的999个目标子集上,我们培训了(一) 一种带有48个转向台视图的差别式每道射线分解器,将全球平均视线和射线特定图像证据注入一个FiLM条件剖面头,在独立的90个对象测试分解上达到中度软深度误差0.035(正态化),以及(二) 在剖面VAE和潜在扩散模型上建造的分基因管,支持无条件取样,与重建多道和图像条件多溶度重建相匹配,其每个对象溶液扩散可量化并可通过无分级指导进行金枪鱼化。 我们进一步分析预测剖面的形态:后热能变磨和有学识的变磨目标既能恢复地上真实剖面宽度而不会降低深度,又能暴露出L1-每道光线损失家族的单调宽度-峰值边界,并激励对形态学门进行原则性再定义. 在两个 DTU 场景上进行实相验证,证实管道转移到了非合成输入. 我们的结果表明,射线式入住配置提供了多视角重建与遗传学前科之间的紧凑、有知识、有不确定性的界面。

articles.title: Toward a Foundation Plug-and-Play Prior for Computed Tomography Reconstruction via a Multimodal Diffusion Model
articles.content: Computed tomography (CT) throughput is limited by scan time, which grows with both the number of projections acquired and the detector integration time for each. Reconstructing high-quality volumes from sparse-view or low-dose measurements therefore depends on an informative prior, typically a neural network trained for one specific scan setting and retrained whenever the modality, geometry, or material changes. We investigate whether a single diffusion model trained across several imaging domains can instead serve as a prior for many CT problems simultaneously. We evaluate the proposed method using the same frozen model on three datasets that differ in modality, beam geometry, material, and degradation type, spanning flaw analysis in additively manufactured metal parts imaged with cone-beam X-ray CT and concrete microstructure imaged with parallel-beam neutron CT. Our proposed method out-performs analytic reconstructions in all three cases, providing a step toward a reusable foundation prior for heterogeneous CT reconstruction problems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 争取建立一个基金会 通过多式扩散模式进行计算图谱重建的插接和插接
articles.content_zh: 计算成的 tomography(CT)吞吐量受扫描时间的限制,扫描时间随着获得的预测数和每个的探测器集成时间而增加. 因此,从稀有视野或低剂量测量中重新构建出高质量的体积,取决于事先的信息,通常是接受过特定扫描设置培训的神经网络,并在模式、几何或材料发生变化时进行再培训。 我们调查在几个成像领域培训的单一传播模型是否可以同时成为许多CT问题的先导。 我们利用三个数据集的同一种冷冻模型评价拟议方法,这些数据集在模式、光束几何、材料和降解类型方面各不相同,对以圆锥束X射线CT和以相平行束中子CT成像的混凝土微结构成像的添加剂所制造的金属部件进行了缺陷分析。 我们提出的方法在所有三个案例中都超过了分析重建,为在各种CT重建问题之前重新使用基础迈出了一步。

articles.title: EchoWM: Open and Enterable Omnimodal World Models
articles.content: We present EchoWM, an omnimodal world model for enterable generative media that responds to continuous navigation while jointly generating 720p video, environmental sound, music and speech. We organize interaction around camera intent: in first-person scenes, it specifies observer motion, while in third-person scenes, camera--character dynamics are learned from data without view-specific controllers. Discrete commands and continuous poses are mapped to a shared metric-scale relative 6-DoF trajectory, with dataset-level calibration preserving motion magnitude across heterogeneous data. To jointly learn audio-visual generation and trajectory control, we construct a complementary data engine and adopt progressive training followed by autoregressive post-training for long-horizon generation. Extensive evaluations show that \model achieves strong trajectory following and high visual quality on public world-model benchmarks, supporting both first- and third-person interaction across varied subjects, and maintaining synchronized environmental sound and speech over long-horizon generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EchoWM: 开放和可进入的Omnimodule世界模式
articles.content_zh: 我们提出EchoWM,这是一个可入门基因介质的全能世界模型,它既能响应持续导航,又能联合生成720p的视频,环境声音,音乐和语音. 我们围绕相机意图组织互动:在第一人称场景中,它指定了观察者运动,而在第三人称场景中,相机-特征动态是从数据中学习的,没有特定视线控制器. 分层指令和连续平面被映射到一个共享的公尺尺度相对的6-DoF轨迹上,数据集级校正在不同的数据中保存运动量. 为了共同学习视听生成和轨迹控制,我们建造了一个辅助数据引擎,并采用渐进式培训,然后对长视距生成进行自转后培训。 广泛的评价表明, " 模型 " 在公共世界模型基准上实现强有力的轨迹并具有较高的视觉质量,支持不同主题之间的第一人称和第三人称互动,并在长视距一代中保持同步的环境声音和语音。

articles.title: A Comparative Study of Label-free Representation Quality Metrics in Deep Learning
articles.content: We present a comparative study of label-free metrics for assessing the quality of representations in deep neural networks to understand their reliability under a wide variety of configurations. We group existing label-free metrics into three families based on their construction and analytically establish connections between metrics within the same family. We then characterise the sensitivity of spectral metrics through controlled synthetic experiments. Finally, all label-free metrics are evaluated against downstream task accuracy across a diverse set of 260 vision models on six datasets spanning generic object classification, fine-grained object classification, scene recognition and geospatial task, stratifying results by architecture class and training objective. We find that intrinsic dimensionality (ID) is the most reliable predictor among the metrics considered. However, the reliability of all metrics, including ID, is moderated by architecture class and training objective. Our results provide a clearer understanding of what label-free representation quality metrics measure, when they are reliable, and how to interpret them in practice.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 深入学习中无标签代表质量计量的比较研究
articles.content_zh: 我们提出了对无标签度量的比较研究,以评估深神经网络中的表达质量,从而了解其在各种配置下的可靠性。 我们根据现有无标签衡量标准构建成三个家庭,并在分析中确定同一家庭内衡量标准之间的联系。 然后我们通过受控的合成实验来描述光谱度量的敏感性。 最后,所有无标签的衡量标准都按照下游任务精度来评价,在涵盖通用对象分类、精细对象分类、场景识别和地理空间任务等6个数据集的260个愿景模型中,按建筑类和培训目标对成果进行分解。 我们认为,在所考虑的衡量标准中,内在维度是最可靠的预测。 然而,包括身份证在内的所有衡量标准的可靠性都由建筑课程和培训目标来调节。 我们的结果使人们更清楚地了解,在可靠时,什么是无标签的表示质量衡量标准,以及如何在实践中加以解释。

articles.title: Neighbor-Aware View Synthesis for Restoring Missing Views in Light-Field Camera Arrays
articles.content: In light-field (LF) imaging systems, dense spatial sampling from a camera array enables powerful post-capture capabilities such as refocusing and depth estimation. However, real-world LF capture is often affected by hardware malfunctions, where one or more cameras in the array fail, leading to missing sub-aperture images and degraded reconstruction quality. This paper addresses the problem of defective or missing view restoration in light-field camera arrays. We propose a novel generative framework that synthesizes the absent views by exploiting information from a carefully selected subset of neighboring cameras. These selected images, along with a positional encoding map indicating both their locations and the desired target view, are fed into a conditional Generative Adversarial Network (cGAN) trained to generate the missing viewpoint in a geometrically consistent manner. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world LF datasets demonstrate that our method produces visually plausible and photometrically accurate reconstructions, outperforming baselines for view interpolation both quantitatively and qualitatively. The proposed framework thus offers a robust and efficient solution for fault-tolerant light-field image acquisition.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在光场相机阵列中恢复缺失视图的邻居- 智能视图合成
articles.content_zh: 在轻地成像系统中,从相机阵列中进行密集的空间采样,可以产生强大的捕捉后能力,如重新确定重点和深度估计等. 然而,现实世界的LF捕捉往往会受硬件故障的影响,阵列中一个或多个相机会出故障,导致分孔图像缺失并退化重建质量. 本文涉及轻地相机阵列中存在缺陷或缺失的视图修复问题. 我们提出了一个新颖的基因框架,通过利用仔细挑选的相机子集的信息来综合所没有的观点。 这些选定的图像以及表明其位置和所期望的目标视图的位置编码图被输入一个有条件的General Adversarial Network(cGAN),以几何一致的方式生成缺失的视角。 对合成和现实世界低地层数据集的广泛实验表明,我们的方法产生了可视的、光度准确的重建,在数量和质量上都超过了观测插入的基线。 因此,拟议框架为获取容错的光场图像提供了一个有力而有效的解决方案。

articles.title: BenthicFlow: Generating Extensible Underwater Environments via Flow Matching
articles.content: Computer vision applications for 3D scene understanding in underwater environments remain challenging due to the lack of high-quality 3D data and the inability of surface-trained models to generalize to underwater scenes. To address this challenge, an emerging trend is to employ generative models to close the data domain gap. However, existing methods assemble large scenes by stitching independently generated tiles post hoc with separately trained models, while demonstrating heterogeneous landscapes only within individual survey sites. We introduce BenthicFlow, a unified framework based on a single conditional flow-matching model that jointly generates aligned textures and depth maps. A MultiDiffusion-inspired sampling procedure reconciles overlapping windows throughout the generative trajectory, enabling spatially extensible RGBD mosaics without a separate stitching model. The generated mosaics are subsequently lifted into explicit 3D benthic environments using surface-aligned Gaussian surfels. Experiments across geographically distinct survey sites demonstrate that BenthicFlow preserves site-specific appearance while generating coherent, large-scale 3D scenes that closely match the target distributions. Code and trained models are available at https://github.com/jacomof/BenthicFlow.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 底盘花:通过流相匹配生成可扩展的水下环境
articles.content_zh: 由于缺乏高质量的3D数据,以及地表训练模型无法通向水下场景,计算机视觉应用在水下环境中用于3D场景理解仍然具有挑战性. 为了应对这一挑战,一个新出现的趋势是采用基因模型来缩小数据领域的差距。 然而,现有方法组合了大片场景,用经过单独培训的模型将独立生成的瓷砖临时缝合起来,同时只在个别调查地点展示出不同的地貌。 我们引入了 BenthicFlow,一个基于单一有条件的流相匹配模型的统一框架,共同生成对齐的纹理和深度图. 多向分散的采样程序可以调和整个基因轨迹的相重叠窗口,使空间上可扩展的RGBD镶嵌能不另设缝接模型. 随后利用地表相通的高斯冲浪将所生成的马赛克升入明显的三维底栖环境. 跨越地理上不同的调查地的实验表明,BenthicFlow保留了特定地点的外观,同时产生与目标分布紧密相匹配的连贯而大规模的3D场景. 守则和训练有素的模型可查阅https://github.com/jacomof/BenthicFlow。

articles.title: CaRGo-T: Causal Reasoning Graph-of-Thought improves Multimodal Humor Comprehension
